system.description:
INVESTED SOUL

Level 10; Price 8,000 gp; Usage sat upon (1 medium creature max); Weight 20 lbs

This simple, woven mat is embroidered with tranquil patterns.

When making Meditation checks whilst sat upon the mat, you gain a +2-status bonus to the check. Furthermore, you may once per day gain the benefit of either a Cure or Restoration spell (8 PP) by meditating on the mat for 10 minutes.

Automated: +2 status is offered on Meditation checks while it is in use (equipped); tick it when you sit on it (interpretation 3). Its Use (10 minutes, once a day, not in an encounter) releases Cure or Restoration at 8 PP from the mat, as an item's spell: none of your own PP. Target yourself.

conditionals.label: Restorative Mat
conditionals.scope: Meditation checks made whilst sat upon the mat
